'''Blackwood Lake''' is a polluted lake in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]]. Its waters are infested by corrupted [[water elemental]]s. Blackwood Lake has been mentioned in the quest item [[:Extended Annals of Darrowshire]] from the quest [[Brother Carlin]] as being the resting place of [[Horgus the Ravager]]'s head.

There is a small Argent Dawn camp here with an [[Argent Medic]] tending to infantry.
